text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: What a magnificent run, Mihono Bourbon!
(Waaaaaaahhh--!)

Having run the race to the very end, 
Mihono Bourbon stood frozen amidst the 
roaring cheers.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Faint tightness in chest detected. 
Commencing scan.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A sense of exhilaration, breathlessness, a 
'flutter' or a 'heart-thump'—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Analysis complete. Confirmed maximum 
level 'Arousal State.'

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: You're the strongest Umamusume, Bourbon!

Starting with a tremendous cheer, the fans 
began calling out one after another.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon, Teio, thank you! You were the 
best!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I knew you could do it, Bourbon! 
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Tears confirmed in the fans' eyes. 
Determining that they are likewise in an 
'excited state.'"

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the courage, Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I see, so this is... what it feels like to 
'inspire courage'.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...'Joy' detected and confirmed, Master.

After changing clothes and stepping out of 
Tokyo Racecourse—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Thanks for today, Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you. I was able to truly grasp 
such rare and valuable knowledge 
firsthand. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! What's with that? You're being so 
modest.

Mihono Bourbon stared intently at Tokai 
Teio's cheerful, smiling face.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I observe some slight swelling around 
your eyes, Teio-san. Are you all right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...! Hey! Why do you always have to 
notice, geez!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Look, I was just really frustrated, okay?! 
Frustrated enough that it made me tear up 
a bit!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Because I totally, completely planned on 
winning! Even the Prez came to cheer me 
on!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Still... far beyond the frustration, it 
was truly so much fun! It exceeded all my 
expectations!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And so—

Tokai Teio looked up at Mihono Bourbon 
with sparkling, yet somewhat daring eyes.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Let's face off again somewhere!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Mhm, very well. See you then!

As Tokai Teio ran off with a wave, Mihono 
Bourbon gave a small wave back in return.
